## create-group

Kind: Write.

Creates an IAM-mode group with no members or policies. If the outcome is
uncertain, list groups before repeating the command.

| Flag            | Type     | Required |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--name`        | `string` | yes      |
| `--description` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode iam create-group --name <name>
```

## create-policy

Kind: Write.

Use a JSON document with a `statements` array (up to 64 KiB). `--document-file`
takes precedence over `Statements` in `--cli-input-json`. The SDK refuses
statements that grant IAM write actions.

| Flag                                       | Type              | Required |
| ------------------------------------------ | ----------------- | -------- |
| `--name`                                   | `string`          | yes      |
| `--description`                            | `string`          |          |
| `--document-file`                          | `string`          |          |
| `Statements` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `[]iam.Statement` | yes      |

```sh
greennode iam create-policy --name <name> --document-file policy.json
```

## create-service-account

Kind: Write.

Creates the account once and saves the issued secret to a new private file.
Confirm creation with `list-service-accounts` before another write if the result
is uncertain.

| Flag            | Type     | Required |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--name`        | `string` | yes      |
| `--description` | `string` |          |
| `--secret-file` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode iam create-service-account --name <name> --secret-file <secret-file>
```

## create-user

Kind: Write.

Choose `--password-file <path>` (or `-` for stdin) or `--secret-file <new-path>`
for a generated password. The generated length is 8 to 50 characters,
default 32. A private destination is required for generation. For an uncertain
result, reconcile ownership with `list-users --name` before further writes.

| Flag                | Type     | Required |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--username`        | `string` | yes      |
| `--password-length` | `int`    |          |
| `--password-file`   | `string` |          |
| `--secret-file`     | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode iam create-user --username <username> --secret-file <private-directory>/password
```

## delete-group

Kind: Write, destructive.

Requires a recognized caller type and a verified IAM group with no users or
policies. An attachment returns `ResourceInUse`.

| Flag         | Type     | Required |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--group-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode iam delete-group --group-id <group-id> --yes
```

## disable-user-mfa

Kind: Write, destructive.

Changes an existing Google authenticator factor and confirms the resulting
state. Requires `--method google`. If the factor is already in the requested
state, the command returns without sending a write.

| Flag        | Type     | Required |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--user-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--method`  | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode iam disable-user-mfa --user-id <user-id> --method google --yes
```

## get-user

Kind: Read.

`User.MFA` exposes nullable `Email` and `GoogleAuthenticator` factor states.
Contact and enrolment details are withheld.

Use `list-user-policies` and `list-user-groups` with the user ID to see attached
policies and memberships.

| Flag        | Type     | Required |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--user-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode iam get-user --user-id <user-id> --query User
```

## reset-user-password

Kind: Write, destructive.

Choose `--password-file <path>` (or `-` for stdin) or `--secret-file <new-path>`
for a generated password. Refuses self-changes and protected users. A reset is
sent once. Coordinate recovery with the user and other administrators if the
result is uncertain.

| Flag                | Type     | Required |
| ------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--user-id`         | `string` | yes      |
| `--password-length` | `int`    |          |

| `--secret-file`     | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode iam reset-user-password --user-id <user-id> --secret-file <private-directory>/password --yes
```

## update-group

Kind: Write.

Reads the current name when `--name` is omitted. Omitting `--description`
preserves it. Reads the group again after a successful update.

| Flag            | Type      | Required |
| --------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--group-id`    | `string`  | yes      |
| `--name`        | `*string` |          |
| `--description` | `*string` |          |

```sh
greennode iam update-group --group-id <group-id> --description <description>
```

## update-policy

Kind: Write, destructive.

Omitted fields retain their current values. The SDK refuses managed policies,
privileged statements, and changes that would affect protected principals or
groups.

| Flag                                       | Type               | Required |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | -------- |
| `--policy-id`                              | `string`           | yes      |
| `--name`                                   | `*string`          |          |
| `--description`                            | `*string`          |          |
| `--document-file`                          | `string`           |          |
| `Statements` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `*[]iam.Statement` |          |

```sh
greennode iam update-policy --policy-id <policy-id> --document-file policy.json --yes
```
